_note: MULTIQ-1108 (owner 2026-11-08: 'Sometimes, people pose multi-question or multi-part question prompts. VD needs to be able to handle both.'). Plan: work/MULTIQ-1108/plan.md (root workspace). vera/multi_question.py splits a prompt into separate questions from its grammatical structure only: question marks, sentence boundaries followed by an interrogative-led clause, and conjoined interrogative clauses with their own auxiliary verb. The word sets below are closed grammatical classes (interrogatives, auxiliaries, leading conjunctions, pronouns), not topic, name or keyword lists. A multi-PART question (one question with several sides or facets, vera.subquery) is never split; it is only recorded.
_mode_note: MULTIQ-1109. Owner 2026-11-08, verbatim: "Sometimes, people pose multi-question or multi-part question prompts. VD needs to be able to handle both." That is a capability requirement, so the shipped default is on. off = no code runs (byte-identical to before; the kill switch); shadow = the split is computed and recorded in the request trace as counts only, nothing user-visible changes; on = each question is routed and answered, or refused, on its own and the page shows one section per question. Only a prompt that holds 2+ questions is affected; a single question runs the unchanged path. Quota (reconciles SIX-1109): each question is its own research unit, one acquisition job per question, an equal share (max_docs_per_prompt // n) of the per-prompt new-document ceiling, one shared request deadline.
_max_questions_calibration_note: PROVISIONAL, UNCALIBRATED (no live multi-question traffic has been measured). Reason (plan b.3): the non-stream path has one 180 s request budget and one acquisition-backed question needs up to 125 s, so more than about one acquisition question per request cannot finish; 3 keeps a help question, a corpus question and one acquisition question inside it, and each question with inline acquisition is one job against jobs_per_hour 30 / jobs_per_day 180. Questions beyond the cap are listed once to ask separately, never merged (merging re-creates the dilution defect) and never dropped. Data that would change it: the multiq split counts (parts, over_cap) and per-part latency in two weeks of request traces.
_subordinators_note: Closed grammatical class (subordinating conjunctions). A word of this class, or an interrogative, that is not the first word of the left clause makes the right clause part of the same question ('when it rains and is cold', 'between what is legal and what is ethical').
_aux_window_note: Grammar bound, not a decision threshold on data: inside one sentence, a clause after ', and' / '; ' / ' and ' counts as its own question only when it starts with an auxiliary, or with an interrogative followed by an auxiliary within this many words ('and what are their side effects', 'and how much does it cost'). 'pros and cons', 'safe and effective', 'and what about cost' never split. Change only if the offline eval set shows a conjoined question it misses.
over_cap_text: Not answered in this request (ask separately):
same_reason_text: Not answered, for the same reason as question {n}.
